title: Challenge
subtitle: 「挑戰／難題」，究竟是在說一般困難、阻礙、一道難關、能力考驗，還是一場艱苦經歷？
description: 「挑戰／難題」，究竟是在說一般困難、阻礙、一道難關、能力考驗，還是一場艱苦經歷？

words.note: challenge 最直接的近義詞之一。當重點只是某事難做、需要努力克服時，difficulty 很自然，但比 challenge 少一點『可接受、可克服』的積極色彩。
words.example: Finding qualified staff remains a major difficulty for the company.
words.exampleZh: 招聘合資格員工仍然是公司的主要困難。

exercises.original: Recruiting experienced engineers is a major challenge for the company.
exercises.zh: 招聘有經驗的工程師是公司的重大困難。
exercises.upgrade: Recruiting experienced engineers is a major difficulty for the company.

options.explanation: 句子只是一般說明招聘很難，沒有特別的阻擋或考驗意味，因此最直接。
較像某一具體因素阻礙招聘，而原句把整件事視為困難。
會強調考驗公司的能力，不是純粹困難。
一次倒退事件，不是持續困難。
通常是阻止進入／參與的門檻。
可指需要處理的事項，但沒有 difficulty 的『難做』意味。

exercises.original: The steep terrain created an unexpected challenge for the survey team.
exercises.zh: 陡峭地形為勘測團隊帶來意外困難。
exercises.upgrade: The steep terrain created an unexpected difficulty for the survey team.

options.explanation: 亦可，但較像必須跨過的一關。
地形令工作變難，是最自然的一般困難。
強度過高，通常表示極度痛苦經歷。
可用，但 difficulty 更貼近『難度增加』。
不是主要在測試團隊能力。

exercises.original: Learning to work with the new software presented several challenges.
exercises.zh: 學習使用新軟件帶來幾項困難。
exercises.upgrade: Learning to work with the new software presented several difficulties.

options.explanation: 多項具體學習困難，最自然。
表示進展倒退，原句沒有。

words.meaning: 要求高的任務；艱巨工作
words.note: 當 challenge 指一項需要大量技能、努力、時間或專注力的工作時，demanding task 很貼切。
words.example: Managing the merger will be a demanding task for the new director.
words.exampleZh: 管理合併工作對新任總監而言會是一項艱巨任務。

exercises.original: Preparing the report in one day will be a real challenge.
exercises.zh: 一天內完成報告會是一項艱巨任務。
exercises.upgrade: Preparing the report in one day will be a demanding task.

options.explanation: 時間短、工作量大，重點是任務要求高。
不是阻擋進展的東西，而是工作本身。
會帶較強情緒／磨難色彩。

exercises.original: Managing three projects at once is a major challenge for the new manager.
exercises.zh: 同時管理三個項目對新經理是一項艱巨工作。
exercises.upgrade: Managing three projects at once is a demanding task for the new manager.

options.explanation: 可以是能力考驗，但題目更聚焦工作本身要求高。
多項項目同時管理，需要大量技能和專注，最精準。

exercises.original: Translating the entire manual accurately is a considerable challenge.
exercises.zh: 準確翻譯整本手冊是一項要求很高的任務。
exercises.upgrade: Translating the entire manual accurately is a demanding task.

options.explanation: 整本手冊＋準確度要求高，典型 demanding task。
可泛指困難，但不如 task 保留原句的工作性質。

words.note: 當 challenge 強調某件事阻止進展、妨礙達成目標時，obstacle 比一般 difficulty 更精準。
words.example: Limited funding is the biggest obstacle to expanding the programme.
words.exampleZh: 資金有限是擴展計劃的最大障礙。

exercises.original: Limited funding is the biggest challenge to expanding the programme.
exercises.zh: 資金有限是擴展計劃的最大障礙。
exercises.upgrade: Limited funding is the biggest obstacle to expanding the programme.

options.explanation: 資金不足直接阻礙擴展，obstacle to 最自然。
可泛指困難，但 obstacle 更突出阻擋進展。
若已失去資金才可能是一次 setback。

exercises.original: A lack of reliable data remains a major challenge for researchers.
exercises.zh: 缺乏可靠數據仍然是研究人員的一大障礙。
exercises.upgrade: A lack of reliable data remains a major obstacle for researchers.

options.explanation: 也可，但 barrier 更常接 access/entry。
數據不足阻礙研究進展，最精準。
可接近，但 obstacle 更一般。

exercises.original: Language differences can create a challenge to effective communication.
exercises.zh: 語言差異可能構成有效溝通的障礙。
exercises.upgrade: Language differences can create an obstacle to effective communication.

options.explanation: 直接阻礙有效溝通，最自然。
也可，但 obstacle to communication 更精準。

words.note: 和 obstacle 很接近，但更常帶『要跨過一道關卡』的比喻感。常見於商業、法律、申請、談判或項目進度。
words.example: Regulatory approval is the final hurdle before the product can launch.
words.exampleZh: 監管批准是產品推出前的最後一道難關。

exercises.original: Regulatory approval is the final challenge before the product launch.
exercises.zh: 監管批准是產品推出前最後一道難關。
exercises.upgrade: Regulatory approval is the final hurdle before the product launch.

options.explanation: final + before launch 明確表示最後一道需跨過的關卡。
也可，但 final hurdle 是更自然固定搭配。
監管批准本身不是已發生的倒退。
較負面而且不保留『關卡』感。

exercises.original: Passing the licensing exam is a major challenge for new applicants.
exercises.zh: 通過牌照考試是新申請人的一大難關。
exercises.upgrade: Passing the licensing exam is a major hurdle for new applicants.

options.explanation: 考試本身是 test，但此處說它是職涯上的 challenge / barrier。
必須跨過才可繼續申請，最貼切。
也可，但 hurdle 更有『過關』意味。

exercises.original: Securing bank finance was the first major challenge in starting the business.
exercises.zh: 取得銀行融資是創業時第一個主要難關。
exercises.upgrade: Securing bank finance was the first major hurdle in starting the business.

options.explanation: first major hurdle 與創業分階段過關的語境很自然。

words.note: 當 challenge 只是中性地表示一個需要處理或解決的問題時，problem 是最常見替代詞之一。不過 problem 通常比 challenge 更負面。
words.example: Traffic congestion is a serious problem for the city.
words.exampleZh: 交通擠塞是這座城市的一個嚴重問題。

exercises.original: Traffic congestion is one of the city's biggest challenges.
exercises.zh: 交通擠塞是這座城市最大的問題之一。
exercises.upgrade: Traffic congestion is one of the city's biggest problems.

options.explanation: 城市需要解決的負面情況，最直接。

exercises.original: Cybersecurity remains a serious challenge for small businesses.
exercises.zh: 網絡安全仍是小型企業的一個嚴重問題。
exercises.upgrade: Cybersecurity remains a serious problem for small businesses.

options.explanation: 也可，但 cybersecurity 作 broad challenge 更常視為 problem。

exercises.original: The shortage of affordable housing is a growing challenge.
exercises.zh: 可負擔房屋短缺是日益嚴重的問題。
exercises.upgrade: The shortage of affordable housing is a growing problem.

options.explanation: 社會問題持續惡化，growing problem 是自然搭配。

words.note: 當 challenge 指需要處理、討論或管理的事項時，issue 很自然。它通常比 problem 更中性，也可用於政策、技術和職場語境。
words.example: Data privacy is an important issue for online services.
words.exampleZh: 數據私隱是網上服務的一個重要問題。

exercises.original: Data privacy is a major challenge for online services.
exercises.zh: 數據私隱是網上服務的一個重大議題。
exercises.upgrade: Data privacy is a major issue for online services.

options.explanation: 需要持續處理和討論的政策／技術事項，最自然。
不一定直接阻止服務運作。

exercises.original: The team discussed the technical challenges before deployment.
exercises.zh: 團隊在部署前討論技術問題。
exercises.upgrade: The team discussed the technical issues before deployment.

options.explanation: technical issues 是高頻搭配，表示要處理的技術問題。
若是阻止部署的一關才更適合。
若是測試活動意思不同。

exercises.original: Access to childcare is an important challenge for many working parents.
exercises.zh: 托兒服務可及性是很多在職父母的重要議題。
exercises.upgrade: Access to childcare is an important issue for many working parents.

options.explanation: 政策／社會語境中需關注的事項，最貼切。
可描述個人困難，但此句更像公共議題。
若強調求職／返工門檻才可。

words.note: 當 challenge 強調對某人的能力、耐力、判斷或品格作出考驗時，test 很貼切。
words.example: The crisis was a severe test of the team's leadership.
words.exampleZh: 這場危機是對團隊領導能力的嚴峻考驗。

exercises.original: The crisis was a major challenge for the new leadership team.
exercises.zh: 危機是對新領導團隊的一大考驗。
exercises.upgrade: The crisis was a major test for the new leadership team.

options.explanation: 危機會檢驗領導能力，最自然。
只說困難，沒有『檢驗能力』意味。
可以，但通常更強調艱辛經歷。

exercises.original: The final presentation will be a real challenge of your communication skills.
exercises.zh: 最後簡報會是對你溝通能力的真正考驗。
exercises.upgrade: The final presentation will be a real test of your communication skills.

options.explanation: test of your skills 是固定自然搭配。
不會接 of your skills 表示能力檢驗。

exercises.original: Leading the team through rapid growth proved a challenge of her judgement.
exercises.zh: 帶領團隊應對快速增長成為對她判斷力的考驗。
exercises.upgrade: Leading the team through rapid growth proved a test of her judgement.

options.explanation: test of judgement 精準表示能力／判斷被檢驗。

words.note: 當 challenge 指一段艱難、令人受壓或需要忍耐的經歷時，trial 很自然。它比普通 challenge 更帶艱苦或情緒負擔。
words.example: The long recovery was a difficult trial for the whole family.
words.exampleZh: 漫長的康復期對整個家庭都是一場艱難考驗。

exercises.original: The long recovery was a serious challenge for the whole family.
exercises.zh: 漫長康復期對整個家庭都是一場嚴峻考驗。
exercises.upgrade: The long recovery was a serious trial for the whole family.

options.explanation: 長時間艱難經歷、需要忍耐，最貼切。
也可，但 trial 更強調艱苦過程。

exercises.original: Caring for a sick relative can be an emotional challenge.
exercises.zh: 照顧生病親人可以是一場情緒上的考驗。
exercises.upgrade: Caring for a sick relative can be an emotional trial.

options.explanation: 長期照護帶情緒壓力與忍耐，最自然。

exercises.original: The months of uncertainty were a challenge they would never forget.
exercises.zh: 數月的不確定是一場他們永不忘記的考驗。
exercises.upgrade: The months of uncertainty were a trial they would never forget.

options.explanation: 漫長不確定帶艱辛經歷色彩。
較少表示整段痛苦歷程。

words.note: 比 challenge 強得多。當某段經歷非常痛苦、漫長、令人恐懼或消耗身心時，ordeal 才適合。
words.example: Being stranded overnight in the storm was a frightening ordeal.
words.exampleZh: 在暴風雨中被困一整晚是一場可怕的苦難。

exercises.original: Being trapped in the storm overnight was a terrifying challenge.
exercises.zh: 在暴風雨中被困一整晚是一場可怕苦難。
exercises.upgrade: Being trapped in the storm overnight was a terrifying ordeal.

options.explanation: terrifying + 被困一整晚，屬極度艱難經歷。
也可，但 ordeal 強度更高。

exercises.original: The rescue operation turned into a nine-hour challenge for the survivors.
exercises.zh: 救援過程對生還者而言變成九小時的苦難。
exercises.upgrade: The rescue operation turned into a nine-hour ordeal for the survivors.

options.explanation: survivors + nine-hour 艱辛經歷，最精準。

exercises.original: The family described the evacuation as a frightening challenge.
exercises.zh: 這個家庭形容撤離過程是一場可怕的苦難。
exercises.upgrade: The family described the evacuation as a frightening ordeal.

options.explanation: frightening evacuation 是典型 ordeal 語境。

words.note: 當 challenge 指進展途中突然出現、令計劃倒退或延遲的困難時，setback 很精準。它不是一般長期障礙，而是一次倒退。
words.example: The loss of funding was a major setback for the project.
words.exampleZh: 失去資金是這個項目的一大挫折。

exercises.original: Losing the funding was a major challenge for the project.
exercises.zh: 失去資金是項目的一大挫折。
exercises.upgrade: Losing the funding was a major setback for the project.

options.explanation: 資金流失令項目進展倒退或延誤，典型 setback。
較像尚未跨過的阻礙，而這裡是已發生的不利事件。

exercises.original: The failed experiment was a temporary challenge, not the end of the research.
exercises.zh: 實驗失敗只是暫時挫折，並非研究終結。
exercises.upgrade: The failed experiment was a temporary setback, not the end of the research.

options.explanation: temporary + failed experiment + progress continues 是固定典型語境。
可以，但未表達『暫時倒退』。

exercises.original: The injury was a serious challenge to her preparations for the tournament.
exercises.zh: 受傷對她備戰賽事造成嚴重挫折。
exercises.upgrade: The injury was a serious setback to her preparations for the tournament.

options.explanation: 受傷令原有準備進度受阻／倒退，最自然。
可能阻礙，但 setback 更適合突發不利事件。

words.note: 和 obstacle 很接近，但 barrier 特別常指制度性、結構性、社會性或實際進入門檻，例如成本、語言、規則和資格要求。
words.example: High fees are a barrier to higher education for some students.
words.exampleZh: 高昂費用是部分學生接受高等教育的障礙。

exercises.original: High fees are a major challenge to accessing higher education.
exercises.zh: 高昂費用是接受高等教育的一大障礙。
exercises.upgrade: High fees are a major barrier to accessing higher education.

options.explanation: access + high fees 是典型 barrier to access 語境。
也可，但 barrier 更常用於制度／可及性。

exercises.original: Language can be a challenge for migrants trying to access public services.
exercises.zh: 語言可能成為移民使用公共服務的障礙。
exercises.upgrade: Language can be a barrier for migrants trying to access public services.

options.explanation: 語言限制 access / participation，是典型 barrier。
也可，但 barrier 更突出可及性限制。
可比喻，但較像一次關卡。

exercises.original: Strict entry requirements create a challenge for smaller suppliers.
exercises.zh: 嚴格入場要求為較小型供應商造成門檻。
exercises.upgrade: Strict entry requirements create a barrier for smaller suppliers.

options.explanation: entry requirements + access 市場，是典型 barrier to entry。
也可，但 business 語境中 barrier 更固定。

words.meaning: 艱苦的鬥爭；非常困難的任務
words.note: 較口語、比喻性的表達。當 challenge 表示某件事很難成功，需要長期努力，而且形勢不利時，可用 uphill battle。
words.example: Convincing investors after the failed launch was an uphill battle.
words.exampleZh: 推出失敗後再說服投資者是一場艱苦戰。

exercises.original: Winning back customer trust after the scandal will be a major challenge.
exercises.zh: 醜聞後重新贏回顧客信任將是一場艱苦戰。
exercises.upgrade: Winning back customer trust after the scandal will be an uphill battle.

options.explanation: 形勢不利、需要長期努力，最符合。
較像一道關卡，不是整段艱苦努力。
醜聞本身可算 setback，但贏回信任是之後的艱苦任務。

exercises.original: Competing against much larger firms is a challenge for the startup.
exercises.zh: 與大型企業競爭對這間初創來說是一場艱苦戰。
exercises.upgrade: Competing against much larger firms is an uphill battle for the startup.

options.explanation: 對手明顯更強，成功困難，最自然。
可用但少了長期不利形勢感。

exercises.original: Without public support, passing the proposal will be a difficult challenge.
exercises.zh: 缺乏公眾支持下，要通過方案將是一場艱苦戰。
exercises.upgrade: Without public support, passing the proposal will be an uphill battle.

options.explanation: 缺乏支持使成功機會低，需要艱苦努力，最貼切。
public support 缺乏不是典型 access barrier。

falseSynonyms.zh: problem 通常帶明確負面意味，需要解決。 challenge 可以是困難，但有時亦帶：
falseSynonyms.point: - opportunity to improve - something worth attempting - a test of ability Learning a new language is challenging. A system failure is a problem.

falseSynonyms.zh: difficulty 很接近，但更純粹表示「難」。 challenge 常多一層： - 需要努力 - 值得克服 - 對能力有要求
obstacle 是會阻止／拖慢進展的東西。 一項 challenge 未必阻擋你，它可能只是要求高。
hurdle 帶「一道關卡」比喻： 它特別適合分階段進展，而不是所有一般困難。
barrier 常見於： 它更像結構性／制度性限制。
setback 是已經發生、令進度倒退的事件。 而 challenge 可以在事件發生前就存在。
test 強調「看看能力／品質如何」。 它不是所有 difficult situation 的一般同義詞。
ordeal 比 challenge 強烈得多，通常涉及： 不能把普通工作難題叫 ordeal。
